justification: Adds page_overrides to the Parramatta ref_components keying so a rule printed inside one 9.10 site section is keyed to that section. Applied to production 2026-11-04: 17 rows re-keyed (9 in 9.10, 8 older in Parts 7/8), each matching the PDF section or the row's own heading. No route code changes.

falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the apply the dry run printed changed=17; after, it prints changed=0 for parramatta_ref_components.
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A 9.10 row on a page wholly inside another site's section keeps the wrong key. Without page_overrides the dry run moved 8 rows (the older Part 7/8 ones only); with it, 17.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions Parramatta 9.10 rows, 20 sections; section title pages read from the live PDF v1.1-2026-04-27.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed the ref number always names the site; the reader sometimes kept the previous site's number after a new site title.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One optional strategy field on the existing ref_components rule; no new file.

functions.name: _derive
functions.what: Derives a precinct key from a row; ref_components now also applies page_overrides
functions.input: a strategy dict and a regulatory_provisions row with ref_number and pdf_page
functions.output: the precinct id string or None when nothing derives
functions.if_none: Returns None when the ref has no usable number, as before
functions.edge_cases: Override only replaces a key with the same parent prefix; title pages excluded
functions.failure_mode: A wrong title page list would mis-key rows; list read from the PDF

break_it.scenario: Row on a title page shared by two sites
break_it.what_happens: Page is excluded from the override range so the ref decides

break_it.scenario: Row whose pdf_page is empty in the database
break_it.what_happens: Override skipped and the ref key stands

break_it.scenario: Key from another family such as 9.1
break_it.what_happens: Not overridden because the parent prefix differs

verified: dry run changed=17 then changed=0 after apply
gaps: Title pages hand-listed for 20 sections of one PDF edition

post_merge.manual_verify: python scripts/derive_precinct_keys.py --council parramatta prints changed=0 for parramatta_ref_components
